title: Analyze User Website Visit Pattern
summary: Given user visit data, determine the website visit pattern with the highest score.
statement: Given user visit data, determine the website visit pattern with the highest score. A pattern consists of a list of three websites visited in order. The score of a pattern is the number of users who visited the websites in the exact order they appear in the pattern. If multiple patterns have the same highest score, return the lexicographically smallest one. Note that the websites in a pattern do not need to be visited consecutively.
constraints: Each user contributes at most once to a pattern score.
hints: Sort all visits by timestamp and group website histories by user.
Generate each user’s ordered three-website subsequences as a set.
Count users per pattern, then minimize (-score,pattern).
Per-user deduplication implements the score definition and tuple ordering resolves ties.
editorial: Per-user deduplication implements the score definition and tuple ordering resolves ties.
